title: Sales & stock reports
subtitle: Figures come from saved demo transactions. Date ranges use Asia/Kolkata; drafts and abandoned bills never count as sales.
profitNote: Profit excludes demo tax and uses saved costs. Sellable returns reverse cost; damaged returns retain cost. This is a sample estimate, not accounting advice.
empty: No completed sales or refunds in this range. Change the dates or complete a demo bill.
invalidRange: Choose valid dates with From no later than Through.
name: Group
trendNote: Bars show receipts and refunds on their posting dates. Days with no activity are omitted.
legacy: Older invoices without category snapshots use their current catalogue category. New invoices preserve category and design snapshots.
stockNote: Stock is a current snapshot and does not change with the sales date range. Low stock is evaluated across all boxes for each SKU.
showing: Showing first {count} rows. CSV includes all matching rows.
noMovements: No movements in this date range.
